scope: Single-view static assets. Directional character sprites excluded; existing forest retained.

assets.name: tiles/grass
assets.description: Seamless repeating grass ground texture viewed directly overhead. Muted dark moss and olive greens matching a cozy medieval forest village. Very subtle tiny grass clusters and low contrast. Fill the square entirely edge to edge with grass, no border, no horizon, no objects, no isolated island. Cohesive crisp retro pixel art, limited earthy palette, upper-left lighting, no text, no UI frame, no antialiasing.
assets.postprocess: Replaced busy generated texture with a low-contrast exact PixelLab drawing; see grass.recipe.json

assets.name: tiles/water
assets.description: Seamless repeating river water texture viewed directly overhead. Muted deep teal and blue, a few subtle short pale horizontal ripple clusters. Flat square texture filled edge to edge, no shore, no border, no objects. Cohesive crisp retro pixel art, limited earthy palette, upper-left lighting, no text, no UI frame, no antialiasing.

assets.name: tiles/farmland
assets.description: Single square patch of cultivated farmland, overhead view. Four tidy parallel rows of tiny green seedlings in dark warm brown tilled earth. Flat square aligned with screen axes, not diamond, nearly fills tile with one pixel transparent margin. Cohesive crisp retro pixel art, limited earthy palette, upper-left lighting, no text, no UI frame, no antialiasing.

assets.name: tiles/stone
assets.description: Single small cluster of three rounded gray stone resource rocks, muted slate gray with warm highlights and moss at base, high top-down 3/4 view, entire object centered, two pixel transparent margin, no ground tile. Cohesive crisp retro pixel art, limited earthy palette, upper-left lighting, no text, no UI frame, no antialiasing.

assets.name: tiles/house
assets.description: One tiny cozy medieval timber cottage, warm ochre plaster walls, reddish brown pitched roof, one dark wooden front door and small window. High top-down 3/4 view with front facing south, clear compact silhouette, centered with two pixel transparent margin, no ground tile. Cohesive crisp retro pixel art, limited earthy palette, upper-left lighting, no text, no UI frame, no antialiasing.

assets.name: tiles/temple
assets.description: Single cozy medieval village temple doubling as a town hall, warm gray stone walls, muted blue slate pitched roofs, modest central bell tower, broad wooden entrance facing south, two symmetric side wings, subtle gold sun emblem. High top-down 3/4 game view, earthy colors, simple readable pixel clusters, entire building centered with six pixel transparent margin, no terrain or surrounding objects. Cohesive crisp retro pixel art, limited earthy palette, upper-left lighting, no text, no UI frame, no antialiasing.

assets.name: ui/weather_clear
assets.description: Single clear-weather HUD icon: warm golden sun with eight short chunky rays, simple readable silhouette, centered, two pixel transparent margin. Cohesive crisp retro pixel art, limited earthy palette, upper-left lighting, no text, no UI frame, no antialiasing.

Cohesive crisp retro pixel art, limited earthy palette, upper-left lighting, no text, no UI frame, no antialiasing.
